recognize_zh: 高倍剛果紅（Congo red）染色可見小血管壁被一圈均質橘紅色沉積物環狀增厚（箭頭），內皮下與中膜被取代，周邊間質亦有同樣沉積；血管壁剛果紅陽性沉積是類澱粉沉積症的典型分布。
features: Small vessel with circumferential salmon-orange congophilic deposits replacing the media (arrow)
Residual patent lumen lined by flattened endothelial cells
Similar orange amorphous deposits in the adjacent interstitium and neighboring vessel
Scattered spindle and inflammatory cell nuclei in loose stroma
describe_en: Congo red-stained section at high power shows a small vessel whose wall is concentrically thickened and replaced by homogeneous salmon-orange amorphous material (arrow), with a residual patent lumen. Similar congophilic deposits are present in the adjacent interstitium and around a neighboring vessel. Findings are consistent with vascular and interstitial amyloid deposition; apple-green birefringence under polarized light and amyloid typing are needed, with AL type favored in the context of multiple myeloma.

ddx.vs: Hyaline arteriolosclerosis is PAS positive but Congo red negative and lacks birefringence.

ddx.dx: Cerebral-type or senile vascular ATTR/Abeta amyloid
ddx.vs: These are equally congophilic in vessel walls; tissue site, clinical context and typing distinguish them from AL.
Fibrinoid necrosis shows brighter eosinophilic material with nuclear debris and inflammation of the vessel wall and is Congo red negative.
